theorem lg_target {R : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [LieRing N] [LieAlgebra R N] [LieRing M] [LieAlgebra R M] (i : N →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) (p : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ M) : i.range = LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra R L p.ker ↔ Function.Exact ⇑i ⇑p := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact Function.Exact.mk (LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_le_ker R L p)
  · intro h
    have h1 : i.range ≤ p.ker := by
      exact LieHom.map_le_idealRange R L p i.range
      exact LieHom.le_ker_iff R L M p h
    have h2 : p.ker ≤ i.range := by
      rw [LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_eq_span R L p.ker]
      exact LieIdeal.span_le R L i.range
    exact Eq.trans h1 h2
